listed.description: False only when state is off.

state.description: pending: switched on, not yet read through; held: the whole catalogue, with why and no code; off: switched off, or no record of its catalogue.

why.description: Why the whole catalogue is held, in words for the owner.

version.description: The catalogue version the network reads the feed at: 1 until a read chooses 2; 0 with no record of its catalogue.

offers_live.description: The products it keeps live, whatever state is, except those counted in offers_later; its search shows them only while state is live.

offers_later.description: The products it keeps live for its search to show later (later).

offers_held.description: The products it holds back one by one.

rev.description: The rev of the copy of the policies document it holds.

problem.description: policies_document_unreadable: its last read of it failed; any copy it held is kept.

path.description: The part, as readCataloguePolicies names it (shipping_profiles[1]).

problems.description: Each part of that copy it dropped, and why (policies_unreadable…).

policies.description: Null until a read at version 2 has asked for the policies document the manifest names, and again once one finds the manifest names none.

id.description: The producer's id for the product, as the network keeps it: up to 1,024 bytes, so one too long for version 2 is still told (unreadable, path /id).

held.description: Why it is held back: a code of CATALOGUE_V2_PROBLEMS that holds, or one of the network's own (the Surfing Dog network's: over_cap, placeholder, and at version 1 price, gtin, multipack, availability, condition). Absent for a product it keeps live.

why.description: The held code's words for the owner.

path.description: For a product that did not read: a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the first member that did not read.

also.description: Beside a code of CATALOGUE_V2_PROBLEMS: its other codes that hold it, in the registry's order.

dropped.description: A product it keeps live: the codes of the members it dropped, and of a warning (hash_mismatch).

group.description: A product it keeps live: the code its product group was read apart for (group_title_differs…).

later.description: search_later (the Surfing Dog network's): a product it keeps live, which its search shows only once it reads catalogue version 2, or, until it is withdrawn, one past its last day to order.

items.description: At most limit, in the network's order of id: each product it holds back, and each it keeps live with a member dropped, a warning, its group read apart, or for its search to show later.

next_after.description: While there are more, the last item's id: pass it as after. Null at the end.

checked_at.description: When it last confirmed what it holds, kept once switched off; null before it has.

description.description: How to read the answer, in words.
